title: 검은 성전 이동 전투 모션 및 전환 설계
status: 설계 확정안; 애니메이션·조작 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않음
schema_scope: authoring design catalog; not a directly loadable engine implementation
canon_changes: 일반검 3타 및 대검 4타의 기존 동작 방향 유지
frame_convention: 0-based integer simulation ticks; intervals [start,end); hitstop ticks excluded from action elapsed time

input.combo_rule: light edge during active/recovery may reserve one next combo until the current action first allows it; expires if action interrupted
input.jump_attack_same_tick: resolve jump/detach once, then choose aerial attack

mobility.wire_style: fixed anchor, fixed length, constrained pendulum
mobility.wire_ground_slack_jump: grounded jump retains slack rope; airborne jump releases either slack or taut rope without extra launch velocity
mobility.immediate_rejump_refill_exception: validated downward-to-upward floor contact may refill once on that event before buffered immediate jump; wall/ledge/slope side contact excluded
mobility.wire_ground_attack: release then grounded action, never an aerial attack
mobility.attachment_exclusion: while rope attached do not auto-grab wall or ledge; detach input cannot also walljump in same tick

hitstop.world_policy: combat-world simulation paused, including rope/actors/projectiles; input/UI sampling continues

render_contract: Master motions and blends are authored on one 3D rig. Animation connection lab uses that rig. If final game uses flat sprite frames, combinations/bridges must be baked first; alpha-crossfading whole sprites is forbidden. This design does not assert a finished game renderer.
